info.title: harnessd
info.description: The HarnessWeaver sidecar: one harness.yaml, served to every language.

get.description: Liveness, and the versions served. The only route without a token (S6).
The effective spec harnessd serves: every layer merged, locks and bounds applied.

post.description:
Run one guardrail provider: what a ``where: sidecar`` guard asks (DESIGNS No. 24).

The provider must be allowed by the served spec's ``plugins.allow`` (S8).
Built providers are kept per name and settings, since heavy ones (a PII
model, a classifier) are slow to build.

post.description:
Run a stage's hook the way a session does: ``input`` fires ``input.before``,
``context`` fires ``context.after`` (ACLs re-checked first, ADR-0030), and
``output`` fires ``output.before``. Every guard and middleware at that hook runs.

post.description:
What the harness does to a tool's result before a model sees it: the
governor's step 9 (sanitizers, truncation, the untrusted label), then
``tool.after`` with its ``tool_result`` guards. The output is the ``ToolResult``.

Acl.title: Acl
Acl.description: Who may see a retrieved item. An empty list means "no restriction" for that part.

ApprovalRequest.title: ApprovalRequest
ApprovalRequest.description: A suspended step waiting for a human.

labels.description: What the caller's run has seen, for the trifecta check.

AuthorizeRequest.title: AuthorizeRequest
AuthorizeRequest.description: ``POST /v1/tools/{name}/authorize``: a call to decide on, never run.

Band.title: Band
Band.description:
Middleware priority bands, outermost first.

The spec assigns bands; a plugin can't place itself in ``baseline`` (S8).

anyOf.description: A duration such as '250ms', '20s', '5m' or '1h30m', or a number of seconds.

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Limits for one run. ``None`` means no limit at this layer.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the item came from, e.g. the context provider name.

ContextItem.title: ContextItem
ContextItem.description: One retrieved document or memory entry.

default.title: Default
default.description: The answer when no stage decides.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Free-form app tags, e.g. channel or region.

Envelope.title: Envelope
Envelope.description: The immutable context every hook event carries.

ErrorInfo.title: ErrorInfo
ErrorInfo.description: The serializable form of an error, as carried by hook events and the wire API.

EvalCase.title: EvalCase
EvalCase.description: One case: the input the task runs on and what the graders compare against.

EvalDataset.title: EvalDataset
EvalDataset.description: A suite of cases for one task (DESIGNS No. 23).

file.title: File
file.description: A file listed in the spec's evals.

EvalRunRequest.title: EvalRunRequest
EvalRunRequest.description: ``POST /v1/evals/run``: a dataset, or one of the spec's own suite files.

private.title: Private
private.description: It's private data such as PII; finding it marks the run private (S3).

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description: Something a guardrail found. Never holds the raw matched text (R9).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Names fields and rules, not content.

GuardAction.title: GuardAction
GuardAction.description:
What a guardrail wants done with the content it checked.

The guardrails module maps actions onto hook outcomes (DESIGNS No. 9).

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: In log_only mode: it would have fired.

GuardFiring.title: GuardFiring
GuardFiring.description: A guard whose verdict wasn't ``allow``, read from the run's trace.

GuardResult.title: GuardResult
GuardResult.description: A guardrail's verdict on one piece of content.

HookEntry.title: HookEntry
HookEntry.description: One middleware on a hook point, as ``GET /v1/hooks`` lists it, in run order.

HookPoint.title: HookPoint
HookPoint.description: A named moment in the run lifecycle. The set is fixed and versioned (R11).

data_class.title: Data Class
data_class.description: Classification of the run's data, e.g. 'confidential'.

untrusted_seen.title: Untrusted Seen
untrusted_seen.description: Untrusted content (retrieved context, tool output) entered.

private_seen.title: Private Seen
private_seen.description: Private data (e.g. PII) was read or found in the input.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where untrusted or private data came from, in order.

Labels.title: Labels
Labels.description: What kind of data a run has touched. Drives the lethal-trifecta check (RULES S3).

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: The deciding rule's id; None if default.

PolicyDecision.title: PolicyDecision
PolicyDecision.description: A ``PolicyEngine``'s answer, with the rule that decided it.

PolicyEffect.title: PolicyEffect
PolicyEffect.description: The outcome of a policy check, from most to least permissive.

PolicyRequest.title: PolicyRequest
PolicyRequest.description: The question a ``PolicyEngine`` answers: may this run, or this call, go ahead?

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The provider's settings from the spec.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: The guard's stage, checked if given.

ProviderCheck.title: ProviderCheck
ProviderCheck.description:
``POST /v1/guards/providers/{name}:check``: one guardrail provider, run in the
sidecar for a guard declared ``where: sidecar``.

Risk.title: Risk
Risk.description: How much harm a misused call could do.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Lower the task's overridable limits for this run (R10).

RunRequest.title: RunRequest
RunRequest.description: ``POST /v1/runs``: run a task to the end, or until it waits for approval.

error.description: Why the run didn't complete: failed, blocked or escalated.

cost_known.title: Cost Known
cost_known.description: False if any model call's cost was unknown (ADR-0012).

RunResult.title: RunResult
RunResult.description: The state of a run: its status, output or error, usage, cost and trace.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description: Where a run is in its lifecycle (DESIGNS No. 18).

SanitizeRequest.title: SanitizeRequest
SanitizeRequest.description: ``POST /v1/tools/{name}/sanitize``: a result the caller's own tool returned.

SideEffect.title: SideEffect
SideEffect.description: What a tool changes when it runs.

level.title: Level
level.description: The adoption level the spec reaches, e.g. 'L3'.

spec.title: Spec
spec.description: The merged spec, every layer applied.

grader_rates.title: Grader Rates
grader_rates.description: Share of cases each grader passed.

SuiteResult.title: SuiteResult
SuiteResult.description: A suite's cases, its pass rate and whether it meets its threshold.

pass_rate.title: Pass Rate
pass_rate.description: Share of cases that must pass.

ToolCall.title: ToolCall
ToolCall.description: A tool call proposed by a model.

ToolInfo.title: ToolInfo
ToolInfo.description: The parts of a tool manifest that policies and middleware decide on.

ToolVerdict.title: ToolVerdict
ToolVerdict.description: What the governor decided about one call, and at which of its steps (DESIGNS No. 17).

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Position in the run's trace, from 0.

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: Token usage of one or more model calls.

task.title: Task
task.description: The task whose output type and rules apply.

ValidateRequest.title: ValidateRequest
ValidateRequest.description: ``POST /v1/validate``: a final output to check against a task.

HTTPBearer.description: The token harnessd was started with (S6).
